text: Stack-buffer-overflow in PackLinuxElf64::unpack (src/p_lx_elf.cpp): when locating a b_info structure inside a local peek buffer the code computes an offset and performs a 4-byte read (via get_le32/get_ne32) without ensuring the offset + sizeof(b_info) fits inside the buffer. A crafted packed ELF can trigger an out‑of‑bounds read on the stack, causing crashes and potential information disclosure or other undefined behavior.
